data.long_meaning: The name Goodard is derived from Old English ‘God’ meaning ‘good’ and ‘weard’ meaning ‘guard’ or ‘spear’. It was often given to children born into families who were known for their courage and faithfulness. In Christian tradition, the name Goodard is a reminder of the power and protection that comes from God. The name Goodard carries the meaning “Good spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Goodard usually hope their child will grow to embody good spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It may have been particularly favored by families who had experienced spiritual or physical hardships and felt the need to reaffirm their faith in God.

Ultimately, the name Goodard can be seen as a manifestation of the Christian virtues of faith, courage, and trust in God's providence.
